problem: The statement says the three-force concurrency test checks whether a linkage can be in static equilibrium under three applied forces. The rule applies to a single rigid body, not to a linkage made of several bodies. A linkage needs each link analysed separately.
fix: In robotics, the concurrency test is applied to each rigid link when checking static equilibrium under three applied forces.

problem: The question says two known lines meet at P, so they are not parallel. The answer adds 'or be parallel to the other two if they are parallel', which is irrelevant here and can confuse the reader.
fix: The third force line must pass through P.
